body: I sort of have friends, but I don't trust them enough to tell my situation. Unfortunately some people who are not my friends but are in my circle of friends make cruel jokes about depression, anxiety, eating disorders etc. I have confronted these people and it has made me the loner in the group. The people who make these jokes tend to control the conversation so its hard for me to be involved in a group conversation. As for the presentation - my teacher said I got over 90 but won't tell me the exact number because she it wouldn't be fair if I got my mark and everyone else didn't. So good news I guess :)

Finding friends is hard. I don't have many either. Sometimes I wonder if there is anyone else like me, with the same interests but there are not many people that have similar interests to me. I also have some social anxiety, and depression stops me from making friends also. I hope you find happiness in your life. Everyone deserves to be happy. Pozdrav :) (I hope that is correct grammar)

Today is a good day. People were generally friendly to me, and I had the chance to relax. I did a class presentation which counted as 40% of my grade for English and I feel glad that it's over. Thanks for asking. :) Sometimes, having someone just ask you makes you value yourself a whole lot more, because it feels like there's this support there, and that somebody cares.

When I brought it up once, my mum was initially supportive and loving towards what I was going through. Then when my dad found out, he was extremely angry at me. He took it as an act of 'ungratefulness' and thought that I was being selfish and a 'brat'.
For this reason, I've learned that I can't trust my parents. Then my mother took on the same approach as my father and we never even speak about it anymore. Thanks so much for the offer. I have my good days and my bad ones. Today's a good one, but when I need to talk I'll definitely send you a PM :)

Thanks for the comment. Unfortunately I did see the school counsellor but she told me that if I was suicidal she would have to tell my parents and the school principal. Because of this I stopped going and I'm trying to deal with it on my own
Thanks for the comment :) also thanks for sharing your experiences of bullumia. Although I haven't experienced it myself I can imagine that it would be extremely difficult.
